newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodian school teacher shot by exam cheat.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian school teacher shot by exam cheat.

text.p: A Cambodian teacher supervising a high school entry exam was shot and seriously wounded by a frustrated student cheat or his accomplice, government officials said on Wednesday.
The teacher was shot at a school in the eastern province of Svay Rieng on the first day of annual exams for senior high school entrance.

"A teacher was shot and seriously wounded in Svay Rieng on Monday. He was brought to hospital in Phnom Penh," interior ministry spokeman, Khieu Sopheak, told Reuters. "The shooting was connected with the exams."
He said the teacher was either shot by a frustrated student caught cheating, or relatives of a student, angry when they were stopped from passing a crib sheet into the examination room.

The annual high school entrance exams have been plagued by rampant cheating in recent years with parents buying answer sheets supplied by corrupt teachers and passing them in to their offspring sitting the exam.
Last year in Phnom Penh frustrated police shot their rifles into the air in a largely frutiless bid to prevent the cheating.
This year military police cordoned off schools to prevent people from approaching too close and the buildings were sealed tight while the exams were in progress, police said.

"Doors and windows were closed to prevent any throwing of rocks with answers," said a local police chief, Ly Naroeun, referring to the practice of parents wrapping an answer sheet around a stone and lobbing it through the window of the exam room.
